motions.motion_text: Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Morzel to approve consent items 3A through 3F with item 3A amended as indicated by changes submitted via the council Hotline and incorporating the change requested by City Attorney Gordon on item 3D.
Council Member Ageton offered a friendly amendment to accept a modification to item 3B clarifying on second reading, the definition of motor vehicle and whether it encompasses trailers.
Council Member Osborne offered a friendly amendment to item 3A indicating that she was present at the June 3 Council meeting and the minutes should be amended to reflect that she was present.
Council Member Wilson offered a friendly amendment to item 3A noting that on page 6, the third paragraph should state that there are no home games until September.
Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Morzel to recommend that the Valmont City Park Concept Plan and the development of phasing strategies move forward to site review.

Council Member Cowles offered a friendly amendment to direct Parks and Recreation to work with Planning and Transportation to reduce the demand for parking while providing for the activities set out in the concept plan.
Council Member Appelbaum moved, seconded by Wilson to introduce and order published by title only, Ordinance No. 7599 placing the question of council compensation on the November 4, 2008 ballot.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 6:3; Ageton, Cowles and Morzel opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Ageton moved, seconded by Appelbaum to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7600 placing the question of allowing council to convene executive sessions on the November 4, 2008 ballot with an amendment on page 12, under Section 9: "Meetings of council," subsection (a), deleting the word "future," prior to the word "purchase."
Council Member Appelbaum offered a friendly amendment to require a two-third vote of the quorum present to convene an executive session.
Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Morzel NOT introduce Ordinance No. 7601 regarding requirements to include places of business on nomination petitions.
Council Member Morzel moved, seconded by Appelbaum to NOT introduce Ordinance No. 7602 regarding increasing the number of signatures required on nomination petitions.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 5:4; Cowles, Espinoza, Gray and Wilson opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Cowles offered a substitute motion, seconded by Wilson to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7602 to increase the number of signatures required from 25 signatures to 50 signatures.
motions.vote_text: The motion failed 4:5; Ageton, Appelbaum, McGrath, Morzel, and Osborne opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Wilson moved, seconded by Osborne to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7603 regarding recall provisions.
Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Ageton to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7604 regarding long term leases as amended to 40 years.
Council Member Appelbaum moved, seconded by Cowles to amend the motion by striking the 2/3 vote.
motions.vote_text: The motion failed 3:6; Ageton, Appelbaum, and Cowles.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Appelbaum moved, seconded by Espinoza to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7605 (option 1) regarding service on boards and commissions.

Deputy Mayor Gray offered a substitute motion, seconded by McGrath to introduce and order published by title only Ordinance No. 7605 (option 1) as drafted in attachment G but to only require residency of one year.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:2; Ageton and Morzel opposed.

motions.motion_text: City Attorney Gordon indicated that the ordinance language could be amended in attachment G, page 35, section 130, to remove the word "electors" and replace it with the word "members," and at the end add the phrase, "and who have resided in the city of Boulder for at least one year immediately prior to appointment to serve on the commission.
motions.vote_text: This was accepted as a friendly amendment.

motions.motion_text: Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by McGrath to suspend the rules and continue the meeting at 10:55 p.m.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 5:1; Ageton, Appelbaum, and Cowles absent, Espinoza opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Appelbaum moved, seconded by Gray to continue the meeting at 11:10 p.m.
Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Morzel to direct staff to draft an ordinance to rezone the Orchard Grove property to Mobile Home Zone (M-HZ ) at council's next meeting on July 22.
Council Member Cowles offered a friendly amendment to bring a draft ordinance to rezone the Orchard Grove property to Mobile Home Zone (MH-Z) to council's August 5 meeting.
motions.vote_text: The friendly amendment was not accepted.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Appelbaum offered a substitute motion, seconded by Morzel to direct staff to initiate rezoning of the Orchard Grove property to Mobile Home Zone (MH-Z).
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:2; Ageton and McGrath opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Espinoza offered a friendly amendment to direct staff to submit this rezoning to the Planning Board on August 7.
Deputy Mayor Gray moved, seconded by Osborne to call-up the site review for 915 Pearl Street.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried 7:2; Cowles and Espinoza opposed.

motions.motion_text: Council Member Cowles moved, seconded by Morzel to express to the Metro Mayors Caucus that the council does not support the resolution regarding ballot issues affecting employers and labor in Colorado.
motions.vote_text: The motion failed 3:6; Ageton, Appelbaum, Espinoza, McGrath, Osborne, and Wilson opposed.

motions.motion_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 1:21 A.M.
motions.vote_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 1:21 A.M.

agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor McGrath called the regular, July 8, 2008 meeting of the Boulder City Council to order at 6:04 p.m. in the Council Chambers.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC PARTICIPATION and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Public participation was heard and staff and council responded; public participation was reopened at 11:00 p.m.

agenda_items.title: CONSENT AGENDA
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council approved consent items 3A through 3F as amended, 9-0, with 3G removed.

agenda_items.title: APPROVAL OF CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES FROM JUNE 3, 2008.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved as amended as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: APPROVAL OF CITY COUNCIL SIX MONTH CHECK-IN MINUTES FROM MAY 19, 2008.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved as amended as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ACCEPT THE SUMMARY OF THE JUNE 5, 2008 CITY COUNCIL STUDY SESSION REGARDING THE COMMUNITY PROCESS TO REVIEW THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING PROGRAM GOALS AND STRATEGIES.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND SECTION 6-1-6 “SUBJECTING ANIMALS TO UNNECESSARY SUFFERING,” B.R.C., 1981, AND SECTION 4-7-3, “LICENSE APPLICATION,” B.R.C. 1981, DEALING WITH THE CONFINEMENT OF ANIMALS IN MOTOR VEHICLES THAT ENDANGERS THEIR SAFETY AND REQUIRING A WRITTEN AFFIRMATION THAT A DOG HAS BEEN INOCULATED AGAINST RABIES AS PART OF THE DOG LICENSE APPLICATION.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved as amended as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 11-3, “INDUSTRIAL AND PROHIBITED DISCHARGES,” B.R.C. 1981, CHANGING CODE LANGUAGE TO COMPLY WITH CODE OF FEDERAL REGULATIONS
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF AN EMERGENCY ORDINANCE ADOPTING SUPPLEMENT NO. 97, WHICH CODIFIES PREVIOUSLY ADOPTED ORDINANCE NOS. 7588 AND 7592, AND OTHER MISCELLANEOUS CORRECTIONS AND AMENDMENTS TO THE BOULDER REVISED CODE, 1981.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Approved as part of the consent agenda.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY AN ORDINANCE DESIGNATING THE SCHOOL AND A PORTION OF THE SITE AT 1215 CEDAR AVE, TO BE KNOWN ALSO AS THE WASHINGTON SCHOOL, AS AN INDIVIDUAL LANDMARK UNDER THE CITY OF BOULDER HISTORIC PRESERVATION CODE.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: THIS ITEM WAS REMOVED BY THE APPLICANT.

agenda_items.title: CALL- UP CHECK IN
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Deputy Mayor Gray indicated a desire to discuss Item 8A-4 regarding the site review for 915 Pearl Street.

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC HEARINGS
CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION RECOMMENDING THE VALMONT CITY PARK FINAL CONCEPT PLAN AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF PHASING STRATEGIES MOVE FORWARD TO SITE REVIEW.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council recommended that the concept plan and phasing strategies move forward to site review, with the reduced-parking friendly amendment, 9:0.

agenda_items.title: INTRODUCTION, FIRST READING AND CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO ORDER PUBLISHED BY TITLE ONLY SEVEN ORDINANCES THAT RELATE TO POTENTIAL AMENDMENTS TO THE CHARTER OF THE CITY OF BOULDER, COLORADO. INCLUDED ARE PROVISIONS THAT WOULD: (1) RAISE THE COMPENSATION FOR COUNCIL MEMBERS; (2) ALLOW THE CITY COUNCIL TO CONVENE EXECUTIVE SESSIONS; (3) DELETE CURRENT REQUIREMENTS THAT A PETITION SIGNER'S PLACE OF BUSINESS BE PROVIDED; (4) RAISE THE NUMBER OF SIGNATURES REQUIRED FOR NOMINATION PETITIONS; (5) AMEND THE PROCESS BY WHICH HOLDERS OF ELECTIVE OFFICE MAY BE RECALLED; (6) EXTEND THE LONGEST POTENTIAL TERM FOR A LEASE OF CITY PROPERTY; AND (7) ALTER THE QUALIFICATIONS FOR SERVICE ON BOARDS AND COMMISSIONS TO ALLOW SOME NON-ELECTORS TO SERVE.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council introduced and ordered published by title only Ordinances 7599, 7600, 7603, 7604 and 7605, with amendments, and voted not to introduce Ordinances 7601 and 7602.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY MANAGER:
Update on Tree Planting, Hazardous Tree Removal and Tree Trimming
agenda_items.outcome_summary: This item was removed from the agenda.

agenda_items.title: UPDATE ON THE USE OF THE CITY'S EDUCATION EXCISE TAX REVENUE IN PURSUIT OF LEED GOLD CERTIFICATION OF THE REBUILD OF CASEY MIDDLE SCHOOL.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council received an update and a BVSD School Issues Committee recommendation on supplemental education excise tax funding.

agenda_items.title: ORCHARD GROVE UPDATE
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Council directed staff to initiate rezoning to Mobile Home Zone (MH-Z) and submit the rezoning to the Planning Board for August 7, by a 7:2 vote.

agenda_items.title: MATTERS FROM THE CITY ATTORNEY - NONE

Report from city attorney on potential change to council procedures that would allow council votes at study sessions in very limited circumstances: (1) to direct staff research or investigations; (2) to make decisions pertaining to procedural matters; and (3) to draw "sense of the body" conclusions following policy discussions.
agenda_items.outcome_summary: This item was removed from the agenda.
